sentence: The New York Knicks pulled off a dramatic comeback in the NBA Finals on June 11, 2026, taking a nearly insurmountable lead.
message: The topic page for "2026 NBA Finals Game 4: Knicks Historic Comeback vs. Spurs" has been built and rendered. It covers: the final score (Knicks 107, Spurs 106) and the record-breaking 29-point comeback — the largest in NBA Finals history; the full series timeline (Knicks lead 3-1 heading into Game 5 in San Antonio); standout performances by Jalen Brunson (36 pts) and OG Anunoby (33 pts, decisive block and putback); Victor Wembanyama's postgame reaction blaming the Spurs' "greediness" and lack of hunger; player and celebrity reactions from Charles Barkley, Carmelo Anthony, Jaylen Brown, Tracy Morgan, Larry David, and others; the post-game street chaos in Midtown Manhattan with over a dozen arrests; and the off-court Dolan vs. NYC Mayor Mamdani feud over the Game 4 watch party. The page is sourced across 7 outlets including BBC Sport, NBA.com, CBS Sports, SI.com, CBS News New York, and Yahoo Sports, all published June 11, 2026.
